title: CI integration: required checks for quality-gating codepaths (schema + e2e integration tests)
creator: Connor O'Brien
description:
We need to enforce non-bypassable CI checks for any PR that changes Optimize quality-gating behavior (state machine, enforcement boundary, override handling), the config-diff schema/validation rules, or rollout-controller coupling.

Context
- Near-miss in beta: gating enforcement drifted between Optimize apply boundary and rollout promotion logic after a refactor; tests passed but didn’t cover the integration path.
- Gating is defense-in-depth. To keep it that way, CI must require:
  1) schema + static validation tests for config diffs
  2) contract tests with eval-harness trigger API
  3) end-to-end tests proving “gate fail blocks apply” and “gate fail blocks promotion”

This ticket wires those tests into required checks (branch protection / merge queue) and adds path-based rules so we don’t require GPU-heavy suites for unrelated changes.

Out of scope
- Adding new gating metrics/thresholds (owned by Applied ML)
- Any new eval suites beyond what ENG-3923/3924 define

Primary owners
- Release Eng/CI: Sahana Iyer, Connor O’Brien
- Test coverage inputs: Leila Farouk (E2E QA), Olivia Grant (eval-harness integration)

Links
- Related PRs:
  - sources/github/redwood/pr-19511-add-config-diff-schema-and-validation-rules.json
  - sources/github/redwood/pr-19579-add-integration-tests-for-gating-end-to-end.json
  - sources/github/eval-harness/pr-412-add-trigger-endpoint-for-optimize-gating.json
  - sources/github/perf-canary/pr-267-add-quality-gate-canary-check-stage.json
- CI working notes:
  - sources/google_drive/shared_drives/engineering/release-engineering/ci-plan-eval-gates.json

Problem statement
Right now, gating-related PRs can merge with only unit tests. We need explicit required checks that validate:
- config diff schema compatibility + migration safety
- enforcement behavior at the boundary (Optimize apply) and at rollout promotion
- eval-harness integration contracts (request/response schema + retry semantics)
- minimal anti-regression coverage for overrides and audit events

Implementation plan
1) Define “gating touch” detection
- Path globs (initial):
  - optimize-service: /optimize/gating/**, /optimize/policy/**, /optimize/config-diff/**, /optimize/audit/**
  - rollout-controller: /rollouts/quality-gates/**, /rollouts/promotion/**
  - console API (read-only surfaces): /console/gates/** (should NOT force GPU suites; requires contract snapshots only)
  - shared schemas: /schemas/optimize/**, /schemas/eval-harness/**
- Add a lightweight script that outputs whether gating-required checks must run, and which tier:
  - Tier 1 (always for gating touch): schema validation + unit tests + contract tests
  - Tier 2 (for enforcement/promotion touch): E2E integration tests in staging env
  - Tier 3 (optional/nightly): extended flake detection, long-context suites (not required check initially)

2) Required checks to add
A) “gating-schema-validate” (Tier 1)
- Validates config-diff JSON schema changes are backward compatible (or include explicit version bump + migration notes)
- Runs static validation rules test matrix (known unsafe combos from runtime notes)
- Emits human-readable failure reason codes (must match Optimize API error payloads)

B) “gating-contract-eval-harness” (Tier 1)
- Contract test against eval-harness trigger endpoint:
  - request: config diff + baseline reference
  - response: metrics summary + artifact pointers + flake score fields
- Uses stubbed eval-harness in CI by default; runs “real” integration weekly (non-required) until GPU pool is stable

C) “gating-e2e-enforcement” (Tier 2)
- E2E test: create proposed config diff → trigger gate run → simulate PASS and FAIL results → verify:
  - FAIL blocks Apply API (Optimize)
  - FAIL blocks canary promotion (rollout controller)
  - override granted + unexpired allows Apply, override expired re-blocks
- Must run with deterministic fixtures; no open-ended sleeps. Gate run job should be mocked at the boundary (don’t require real model evals in required checks).

D) “gating-migrations-sanity” (Tier 1)
- If PR touches persistence for gate runs, require:
  - migration lints
  - rollback path verified (down migration present or explicitly documented as irreversible)

3) Branch protection + merge queue
- Add required checks on main:
  - gating-schema-validate
  - gating-contract-eval-harness
  - gating-e2e-enforcement (only when gating touch detected)
- Ensure merge queue uses the same required checks (avoid “green on PR, red on queue” drift).
- Restrict bypass:
  - only release-engineering oncall can override required checks
  - any override must include a reason string in the merge UI and will be logged to audit channel (follow-up task created)

4) Runtime/cost constraints
- Required checks must complete in <= 15 minutes P95 for Tier 1 and <= 25 minutes P95 for Tier 2.
- No GPU allocation in required checks for MVP (mock eval runs). If we later add real GPU smoke suites, they must be bounded (<= 5 min) and scheduled via dedicated CI GPU pool.

Acceptance criteria
- A PR that modifies gating enforcement, schema, or rollout coupling cannot merge without passing the required checks above.
- A PR that only changes Console UI copy or docs does NOT trigger Tier 2.
- E2E fixture covers:
  - gate fail blocks apply
  - gate fail blocks promotion
  - override happy path + expiration
- Clear developer messaging in CI output: what failed and how to reproduce locally.
- Documented in /docs/engineering/ci/quality-gates-checks.md (or equivalent) with:
  - how to run each check locally
  - how to update snapshots/contracts
  - how to request a temporary override

Risks / notes
- Flakiness: Do not make any real eval suites required until flake score/quarantine flow (ENG-3929) has proven stable.
- Drift: Keep contract tests pinned to explicit schema versions; failures should point to the exact field mismatch.

Rollout plan
- Phase 1 (this ticket): enable checks as “required for gating touch only” on main.
- Phase 2: after 1 week, require Tier 2 for rollout-controller changes as well.
- Phase 3: evaluate adding a tiny real-GPU smoke gate as non-required “informational” first.

Status updates
- 2026-01-22 (Sahana): Added path-based detection script; validated it flags changes in /optimize/gating/** correctly. Still need to handle shared schema changes.
- 2026-01-30 (Connor): Drafted branch protection rule set; waiting on Leila to confirm e2e fixtures don’t depend on real eval jobs.
- 2026-02-07 (Sahana): Contract test wiring mostly done; currently failing due to artifact pointer field rename (coord with Olivia on final shape).
- 2026-02-12 (Sahana): Tier 2 E2E runs in CI are stable (10/10). Next: tighten required-check enforcement in merge queue and add override logging.

Open questions
- Do we want to require “gating-audit-events” check when /optimize/audit/** changes? (likely yes; minimal snapshot assertion)
- Should schema validation require a formal version bump when any field is removed (even if unused)? (lean yes; confirm with Jonas/Applied ML + Console consumers).
